Work

Business sites, blogs, and small web apps. Concept sites are labeled as concepts.

Sonoran HVAC & Electric

Concept site for a home-services company

A full marketing site for a Tucson HVAC and electrical contractor, with click-to-call, quote requests, service-area pages, and review highlights. Built as a demo of what a local trades business can launch with.

RV Tech Connect

Service marketplace web app

Connects RV owners with certified mobile RV technicians nationwide for emergency repairs, scheduled maintenance, and diagnostics at their location, with live technician status and arrival times.

Bark Dating

Community web app, pre-launch

Upload your dog and it's handed to a stranger. Browse the community to hunt it down, find your dog, and meet the person holding it. The pre-launch site collects sign-ups by city to decide where to launch first.

learn-code.com

Online coding school

A one-person coding school with long-form courses and short posts on React, TypeScript, Next.js, and shipping real software. Rebuilt in April 2026 with a course catalog, a blog, and student sign-in.

iChef

Pre-launch site with feedback form

A landing page that gathers dish reviews from friends and family before a home-cooking business launches, turning early tasters into testimonials.

The Freed Mouse

WordPress blog

A personal WordPress blog with a custom header, sidebar navigation, and a post archive the owner updates on their own.
